title: Garlic-Pepper-Parmigiano Creamy Gnocchi
instructions: Boil the gnocchi in salted water.
Thinly slice the garlic. Briefly fry in butter, 1-2 minutes is enough.
Add heavy cream and gently simmer for a bit.
Lower the heat, add grated cheese and keep stirring.
Add the gnocchi alongside a bit of their water, toss until glossy and creamy.
